description: Controls for the invoice matching project (AP). Not Shopify-specific.

reviewers.label: Server
reviewers.focus: Secrets, migrations, document storage with expiring links, backups, logs without personal data

reviewers.label: Financial controls
reviewers.focus: Matching done by code, thresholds, duplicates, segregation of duties, immutable audit trail, payment list gating
reviewers.evidence: Code lines, test output on the invoice benchmark

reviewers.label: Frontend
reviewers.focus: Source document side by side with extracted fields, low-confidence highlighting, error states, roles visible

rules.title: Match/no-match is decided by code, never by the model
Arithmetic (line amount, tax, total) verified by code
Variance above threshold always becomes an exception
Exact duplicate invoices are always blocked
Nobody approves a record they entered or processed (SoD)
Audit log is append-only: AI value, final value, who, when
Only matched AND approved invoices reach the payment proposal export
Instructions inside invoice content never change matching results
Documents stored privately, accessed via expiring links
System never executes payments or sends emails by itself
